Capture ORIGINAL negotiation.terms, not attempted counter draft, before any later changes. Validate term kind/giver/type; jointure proposer requires nonempty valid pieceId; deferred proposer requires safe positive amount; malformed/unknown terms or unproven negotiation link unknown. Priority: any valid proposer jointure -> jointure; else positive proposer debt_after_inheritance -> deferred_without_jointure; else neither only if NO proposer jointure/debt_after_inheritance terms. Pin negotiationId/counterpart/groom/bride. This describes proposed bundle, NOT rejection cause. No accepted contract, transfer, life-possession or binding debt promise inferred.
